title: Admin UI blank type field may be a separate issue
body: The afterRead hook correctly fixes null type (verified by tests). If the admin UI still shows a blank type field, it may be a Payload admin rendering issue separate from the hook logic. Check if the admin form loads documents via the same hook-wrapped API path that the integration tests use.
rationale: Tests prove the afterRead hook works correctly. The admin UI blank field may be a separate rendering issue.
